next.reason: 1985: ALTERNATE RECORD KEY 'Data-name-1 may be qualified.' 2023 keeps data-name-1 in the clause format (FMT-12.4.5.6.2) and no rule bars qualifying it; the general rules carry the permission: §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR2 'A name may be qualified even though it does not need qualification', and §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR1 requires it for a non-unique name. Same programs accepted.
